build_nosehoover_nvt_thermostat: build a NoseHooverNVT thermostat with a target temperature and damping time for NVT molecular dynamics
build_bussi_thermostat: build a BussiThermostat with a target temperature and coupling time for stochastic velocity rescaling
build_langevin_thermostat: build a LangevinThermostat with a target temperature and friction coefficient for stochastic dynamics
build_berendsen_npt_thermostat: build a BerendsenNPT thermostat with temperature and pressure for constant pressure molecular dynamics
save_restore_thermostat_state: save and restore thermostat state to and from a checkpoint dict for NoseHooverNVT or BussiThermostat
